messages.subject: Reagarding CHG and CHH DMR
parts:
Dear Altuna,
When i am doing CHG and CHH analysis on methylation file generated from bsmap and putting context= CHG in readMeth option. Yet it is giving DMR output of CG context.

So i decided to separate CHG and CHH meth call by using grep and then calculated the DMR. Is this right way to calculate DMRs at CHG and CHH context.



Thank you.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Reagarding CHG and CHH DMR
parts:
yes, it is the right way to separate files. Context argument is for the file to be provided by the user. The user should provide separate files. This blogpost is linked at the vignette and discussed many times in this forum.
http://zvfak.blogspot.de/2012/10/how-to-read-bsmap-methylation-ratio.html

Best,
Altuna
